What is White-Label Electronic Signature Software?

White-label electronic signature software lets you remove a vendor’s branding and replace it with your own. Instead of your customers seeing “Powered by [Vendor],” they see your branding throughout the signing experience.

White-labeling can range from simple branding changes, like logos and colors, to deeper control over domains, email, and embedded experiences. Some providers also support different branding for each customer on your platform.
White Labeling for Your Own Brand

In this case, you want the signing experience to look like your product. Email invitations and reminders come from your domain. The signing page shows your logo and colors. Your customers never see the name of the company whose API you’re using behind the scenes.
